findings.title: preposition places corruption inside the land domain
findings.claim: The locative preposition places corruptive striving inside a definite, public land-domain.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the locative preposition at 5:33:8:1; governing the definite land phrase makes the corruption operate within a named terrain rather than in abstract space.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see where the corruption operates.
findings.containment: This is a local spatial relation; it does not generalize every use of the preposition or every meaning of land.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: the land is the public domain of corruption
findings.claim: The definite land names the public domain in which the corruptive offense is pursued and from which removal can later occur.
findings.mechanism: The land carrier at 5:33:9:2 is linked by the surrounding striving-and-corruption construction to the later land occurrence at 5:33:24:2, changing a generic offense into a territorial one.
findings.reader_payoff: The same public domain becomes visible as both the arena of harm and the possible source of expulsion.
findings.containment: The claim is confined to this ayah's two land phrases and does not assert an unrestricted territorial theory.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: corruption is both manner and aim of striving
findings.claim: The accusative corruption term characterizes the striving both by the manner in which it is carried out and by the disorder it aims to produce.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:10:1 is attached to the striving at 5:33:7:2 and the land at 5:33:9:2; that contact makes corruption the defining profile of the effort rather than incidental damage.
findings.reader_payoff: Corruption becomes the operation's defining aim and manner.
findings.containment: The two grammatical pressures coexist locally; this does not turn every accusative corruption expression into the same construction.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support preserves the reading, while the packet explicitly requires form- and construction-bounded qualification.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey düzgün, elverişli veya dengeli durumunu yitirerek bozuk hâle gelir.
branch_activations.carrier: The corruption noun carries the branch's loss-of-soundness core.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The striving verb supplies a separate ongoing activity for the corruption term to qualify.
branch_activations.activation: The corruption carrier contacts the striving predicate as its manner and directed profile.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The second offense is newly legible as effort that operates toward disorder, not incidental harm.
branch_activations.boundary: The local accusative supplies both manner and purpose pressure; no unrestricted root-wide claim is made.

findings.title: particle turns the penalty catalogue into recompense content
findings.claim: The subjunctive particle turns the following passive alternatives into the content of the recompense named at the opening.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:11:1 nominalizes the following penalty verbs and joins them to the recompense frame at 5:33:2:1, changing a loose list into the predicate content of the decree.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence visibly pivots from defining the offenders to stating what their recompense consists of.
findings.containment: The claim concerns this complement relation and does not assign an independent lexical meaning to the particle.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: first passive penalty is intensified killing
findings.claim: The first passive Form II verb foregrounds the offenders as recipients of intensified killing while suppressing the executor.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:12:1 is passive and subjunctive within the penalty complement; its Form II shape gives the first option greater force while the passive voice shifts attention from agent to punished group.
findings.reader_payoff: The first option reads as an imposed, intensified termination rather than an unmarked killing word.
findings.containment: The force is form- and construction-bound; no unrestricted claim about the root or every passive killing form is made.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support preserves the reading, while the packet explicitly requires form- and construction-bounded qualification.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir canlının yaşamını sona erdirip canını bedeninden ayırma eylemidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The first passive penalty form carries the branch's life-taking meaning.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The crosswise limb phrase at 5:33:20:1 supplies a distinct differentiated penalty pattern.
branch_activations.activation: The life-taking carrier contacts the separated alternatives, making killing one capacity-specific response among several.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The first option is newly legible as interruption of life within a differentiated catalogue.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is the ordinary life-taking core; Form II intensification remains a construction qualification.

findings.title: first disjunction opens the alternatives
findings.claim: The first disjunction opens the penalty catalogue as alternatives rather than a cumulative sequence.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:13:1 follows the first passive penalty and introduces the next one, changing the catalogue from an undifferentiated accumulation into separated options.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the decree begin to enumerate distinct modes of response.
findings.containment: This finding concerns the local list structure and does not resolve legal questions outside the packet.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: passive crucifixion becomes rigid public display
findings.claim: The second passive Form II verb adds crucifixion as a distinct, publicly exposing alternative.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:14:1 remains inside the passive subjunctive series and follows the first disjunction; its crucifixion sense and rigid public-display pressure change the second option from generic severity to exposed immobilization.
findings.reader_payoff: A separate public display is perceptible within the alternatives.
findings.containment: The crucifixion branch is retained with its local Form II and public-display restriction; firmness is not treated as an unrestricted replacement gloss.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir insanın öldürülmesi amacıyla asılması veya dikilmiş bir düzeneğe bağlanması temel eylemdir.
branch_activations.carrier: The crucifixion form carries the packet branch's hanging-for-death meaning.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The killing alternative at 5:33:12:1 establishes the penalty field in which crucifixion is a distinct mode.
branch_activations.activation: The crucifixion carrier contacts the prior killing option through the repeated passive disjunction, yielding exposed immobilization as a separate response.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The second option is newly legible as public hanging-for-death rather than an undifferentiated severe act.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is the specific crucifixion use; ordinary hanging and cross-shaped sign extensions are not activated.

findings.title: second disjunction adds the cutting alternative
findings.claim: The repeated disjunction introduces the cutting option and maintains the alternative-by-alternative structure.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:15:1 repeats the same disjunctive hinge after crucifixion, contacting the next passive verb and giving the list an audible, segmented skeleton.
findings.reader_payoff: The four-part catalogue remains legible as a sequence of alternatives.
findings.containment: The sound and syntax are local observations, not a ranking of the listed penalties.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: cutting verb encodes thorough crosswise severance
findings.claim: The Form II passive cutting verb, agreeing with the limb subject, describes thorough severance across the specified body-part complex.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:16:1 waits for the limb subjects and crosswise qualifier at 5:33:17:1 and 5:33:20:1; their contact fixes the operation as intensive bodily severance.
findings.reader_payoff: The cutting is seen as a complete patterned severance, not a vague bodily injury.
findings.containment: The bodily branch is retained; road-cutting and other root extensions remain only bounded background pressure.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support preserves the reading, while the packet explicitly requires form- and construction-bounded qualification.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin bütünlüğünü bozarak onu başka bir şeyden ayırma eylemi çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The cutting verb carries the packet branch's separating-cutting meaning.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The opposition noun at 5:33:20:1 supplies the separate crosswise relation.
branch_activations.activation: The cutting carrier contacts the directional qualifier and limb subject complex, fixing bodily severance as the local operation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The third option is newly legible as separation of bodily integrity in a specified pattern.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains bodily cutting; road-cutting and relation-severance are not separately asserted.

findings.title: hands mark agency under passive cutting
findings.claim: The possessed hands are literal passive patients, while their hand-function keeps agency and capacity pressure visible.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:17:1 is the subject/patient of the cutting verb, and its possession plus pairing with feet connects literal anatomy to the offender's operative reach without erasing the body referent.
findings.reader_payoff: The penalty can be read as disabling both hands and the capacity they represent.
findings.containment: Literal hands remain primary; the agency reading is a bounded pressure from the paired construction, not a metaphorical substitution.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: el ve elin uğradığı bedensel durumlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderim, insan bedenindeki el organıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The hand occurrence carries the packet branch's literal body-organ meaning.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The passive cutting verb at 5:33:16:1 supplies the separate bodily event.
branch_activations.activation: The literal hand carrier becomes the patient of cutting, preserving anatomy as the primary referent.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The penalty's bodily target is newly precise: the hands themselves.
branch_activations.boundary: This activation stays with the organ branch and does not replace it with power or ownership.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, güç ve bir işi yapabilme yeterliğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The hand occurrence also carries the packet branch's bounded capacity pressure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The paired feet at 5:33:18:2 supply a distinct mobility capacity.
branch_activations.activation: Hand and foot carriers contact one another under the crosswise cutting construction, allowing operative agency to remain perceptible alongside literal anatomy.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The penalty becomes newly legible as disabling effective capacity as well as cutting a limb.
branch_activations.boundary: Capacity is a contained secondary pressure; the literal hand reading remains intact.

findings.title: exclusive legal restriction opens the decree
findings.claim: The restrictive opener closes the legal frame around the recompense sentence and its four listed options.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:1:1-2 precedes the recompense noun and limits the sentence that follows, changing the opening from a general announcement into a bounded decree.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader encounters a closed frame before any penalty is named.
findings.containment: The restriction is a local grammatical function and does not claim that every occurrence of the particle has this exact scope.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: conjunction pairs hands and feet
findings.claim: The conjunction makes hands and feet a paired patient set under one cutting verb before the crosswise detail arrives.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:18:1 coordinates the feet with the already named hands under the passive cutting construction, changing two body references into one paired penalty target.
findings.reader_payoff: Agency and locomotion are joined before the directional pattern is specified.
findings.containment: The conjunction establishes coordination only; it does not itself supply the crosswise interpretation.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: feet add mobility loss to agency loss
findings.claim: The possessed feet add loss of movement to the cutting of operative hands.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:18:2-3 is coordinated as a second passive patient with the hands; contact with the movement sense of feet makes mobility loss explicit beside agency loss.
findings.reader_payoff: The penalty disables movement as well as action.
findings.containment: The focus remains literal feet under the cutting verb; no independent figurative theory of feet is asserted.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, insanın ve çoğu hayvanın bilinen bacak uzvudur.
branch_activations.carrier: The foot occurrence carries the packet branch's literal leg-limb meaning.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The passive cutting verb at 5:33:16:1 supplies the separate operation.
branch_activations.activation: The foot carrier is coordinated with the hands as a cut patient, so the literal limb becomes the bodily site of movement loss.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The penalty is newly legible as disabling the movement limb alongside the hand.
branch_activations.boundary: The literal limb branch is retained; the related pedestrian branch is reserved for the attributed HFT trace.

findings.title: preposition turns source into manner geometry
findings.claim: The preposition shifts the phrase from naming limbs to specifying the manner and source geometry of their cutting.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:19:1 governs the following opposition noun, changing the reader's attention from the paired limbs to the pattern by which the operation is carried out.
findings.reader_payoff: The construction narrows from what is cut to how it is cut.
findings.containment: The finding concerns this local attachment and does not generalize the preposition's other functions.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: crosswise opposition turns limbs into a legal diagram
findings.claim: The opposition noun specifies that the paired limb cutting follows opposite or alternating sides.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:20:1 contacts the hand-and-foot pair at 5:33:17:1 and 5:33:18:2, changing an unspecified cutting into a directional, crosswise diagram.
findings.reader_payoff: The asymmetry of the penalty becomes perceptible.
findings.containment: The local construction selects crosswise contrariety; succession, office, and other root meanings are not activated.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support preserves the reading, while the packet explicitly requires form- and construction-bounded qualification.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Taraflar aynı yolu veya tutumu izlemek yerine birbirinden ayrı yönler tutar.
branch_activations.carrier: The opposition noun carries the branch's separate-path-and-opposition meaning.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The hands and feet at 5:33:17:1 and 5:33:18:2 supply the paired sides that can differ.
branch_activations.activation: The opposition carrier contacts the two limb patients under the cutting verb, converting difference into a crosswise penalty geometry.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The third option is newly legible as asymmetric, opposed-side severance.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the local crosswise specialization is activated; succession and other opposition uses are not.

findings.title: final disjunction introduces exile
findings.claim: The final disjunction keeps exile as the fourth alternative within the same restricted catalogue.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:21:1 follows the crosswise cutting option and introduces passive removal, changing the list's final movement from bodily penalty to territorial removal.
findings.reader_payoff: Exile arrives as a structurally equal alternative rather than an afterthought.
findings.containment: The claim is limited to the local disjunctive series and does not adjudicate external legal interpretations.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: rare passive removal fuses exile with negation
findings.claim: The passive removal verb makes banishment from the land the final listed mode and retains the bundle's negation pressure as a qualification.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:22:1-2 is passive and subjunctive within the same complement as the bodily penalties; its contact with the following ablative phrase turns removal into a land-directed negation of presence.
findings.reader_payoff: Exile reads as juridical removal from the domain, not merely relocation.
findings.containment: The local passive banishment reading is retained; the packet's root-assignment tension is not normalized beyond the supplied evidence.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: from-preposition reverses the earlier in-preposition
findings.claim: The ablative preposition makes the land the source from which offenders are removed, reversing the earlier in-land relation.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:23:1 governs the second land phrase and contacts the earlier locative relation at 5:33:8:1, changing the land from the site of action into the source of expulsion.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence visibly reverses its earlier spatial direction.
findings.containment: This is a relation between the two local prepositional phrases, not a claim that every ablative phrase carries a reversal.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: second land closes the domain-to-expulsion bracket
findings.claim: The repeated definite land closes a domain bracket: the place of corruption becomes the source of expulsion.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:24:2 repeats the land noun after the ablative preposition and contacts its first occurrence at 5:33:9:2, changing two mentions into a single crime-to-removal domain.
findings.reader_payoff: The same public ground holds the offense and authorizes the described removal.
findings.containment: The bracket is an ayah-level textual relation; it does not infer additional geography.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: demonstrative compresses the penalty set
findings.claim: The distal demonstrative gathers the alternatives into one evaluative object before disgrace is predicated.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:25:1 points back over the completed penalty series, changing a succession of options into one object that can receive the following evaluation.
findings.reader_payoff: The list is compressed before its worldly consequence is named.
findings.containment: The finding concerns deictic scope and does not erase the alternatives that the pointer gathers.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: lām assigns disgrace as offender portion
findings.claim: The lām assigns the disgrace to the offender group as their portion.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:26:1 begins the fronted allocation phrase and contacts the offender pronoun and disgrace predicate, changing disgrace from nearby description into an allocated consequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The consequence is heard as belonging to the offenders, not merely occurring around them.
findings.containment: The claim is limited to assignment/specification in this phrase and does not turn the preposition into a lexical root.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: recompense is framed as proportional return
findings.claim: The construct recompense noun frames the penalty as a return answering conduct; the local context settles its valence as punitive.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:2:1 is construct-bound to the action-defined class and contacts the hostile and corruptive acts that precede the penalty list, changing an unframed burst of force into an answer-to-conduct relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The penalties are legible as a settled response rather than an unstructured catalogue.
findings.containment: The root's reward/punishment range is preserved, while this construction locally selects punitive return.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iyiliğe ya da kötülüğe denk karşılık verme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Yapılan eylem, niteliğine uygun ve onu karşılayacak bir iyilik ya da kötülükle yanıtlanır.

branch_activations.activation: The recompense carrier contacts the named hostile act, so the penalty list is read as an answer to conduct.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The opening penalty is perceptible as a locally punitive, conduct-linked return.
branch_activations.boundary: The broader reward-or-punishment range remains visible; this local construction selects punitive return.

findings.title: pronoun routes consequence back to the offender class
findings.claim: The plural pronoun carries the action-defined offender group unchanged into the consequence clause.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:26:2 completes the allocation phrase and contacts the relative clause that defined the group, changing the sentence from penalty description into consequence assigned to the same actors.
findings.reader_payoff: The people named by their acts remain in view after the catalogue ends.
findings.containment: The continuity is grammatical and local; it does not add a new class of offenders.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: public disgrace predicates the penalty set
findings.claim: The indefinite predicate names the penalty set as public disgrace, not only private guilt.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:33:27:1 is predicated of the demonstratively gathered penalty set and contacts the worldly domain phrase, changing the legal catalogue into a publicly visible consequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The penalty is characterized by exposed abasement as well as by bodily or territorial restriction.
findings.containment: The claim stays with the supplied disgrace predicate and does not collapse it into inward shame.

epistemic.reason: Trusted source support, accepted word alignment, and the local focus construction jointly support the bounded reading.

findings.title: temporal preposition locates disgrace in this world
